title: Entralink run
description: How a run of the Entralink roguelike is laid out (docs/paperwhite2/design/entralink-roguelike-prototype.md): its rounds, each a number of rooms drawn at random from rooms/ (role room, kept to that round or to none) and, for the first two, an optional boss (role boss), then the final room (role final). Rooms are drawn without repeats while unused ones fit; then the least used come up again, never one twice in a row. tools/paperwhite2/entralink_run.py checks it and writes it into paperwhite2/entralink_run_config.h.

rounds.description: Rounds 1, 2 and 3 in order; the final room follows the last. At most 15 rooms in all, the final's included

room_maps.description: The zones of the rooms before the final one, taken in turn; each needs a bottom exit, where a room is entered

field_weather.description: The forest's field weather (include/system/zone_weather.h) in the rooms with no weather of their own; the forest's own if left out

rooms.description: How many rooms of role room are drawn for it, from those kept to it and the generic ones; when unused ones run out, rooms come up again

boss.description: Rounds 1 and 2: whether a boss room ends it, drawn from the boss rooms kept to it, else from the generic ones; false if left out
